title: Local API Client
description: A free, local-first API client for VS Code. Requests are plain YAML files in your repository: environments, OAuth 2.0, tests, scripts and a collection runner. No account, no limits, no telemetry.

title: AI Handoff MCP
description: @handoff in the chat: see where the last AI agent stopped, rate a prompt before you send it, and continue the task.

title: Saarthi AI
description: Copilot-style inline completions and agent chat, running entirely on your machine via Ollama.

title: VS Code Client for Grok Build (Unofficial)
description: Unofficial community extension, not affiliated with or endorsed by xAI. Native VS Code chat UI for the official Grok Build CLI (ACP over `grok agent stdio`): multi-session, plan/execute, diffs, context.

title: Notebook Review for GitHub Pull Requests (Jupyter .ipynb)
description: Review Jupyter notebooks (.ipynb) in GitHub pull requests inside VS Code: rendered cell-by-cell diffs of code, Markdown, LaTeX and outputs, with line comments on any cell that post to GitHub as a normal PR review.

title: Layers for Claude Code
description: Everything Claude Code doesn't show you: every Claude account and its limits with one-click switching, usage analytics, chat looks and mods, and every command in plain English.

title: TF2 SourceScheme Preview
description: Live preview of a TF2 HUD's sourcescheme.res: server browser, options dialog and console, with every setting behind each element.

title: Stata-Kernel-Jupyter
description: 在 VS Code 中用 .ipynb 直接运行 Stata —— 注册 Jupyter Stata 内核，支持 Quarto/Markdown/HTML 多格式与 AI Agent（MCP）。
